title: Senior Cloud Security Architect :: Bethesda, MD (Hybrid/Remote)
description:
Senior Cloud Security Architect

Bethesda, MD | Hybrid/Remote | 5-month contract

Job Summary:

Seeking for an experienced professional to lead the design and implementation of secure cloud infrastructure across our AWS-based environments. This role focuses on securing network boundaries, containerized workloads, cloud-native data storage, and overall cloud infrastructure components. You will be the security expert in cloud architecture projects, ensuring all designs align with best practices and compliance requirements.

Core Work Activities:

  • Design and maintain secure architectures for cloud infrastructure in AWS, AliCloud, and other cloud services.
  • Implement and validate network segmentation, ingress/egress controls, and virtual firewall configurations.
  • Secure containerized workloads in Amazon EKS or self-managed Kubernetes clusters.
  • Collaborate with DevOps and platform teams to integrate security into CI/CD pipelines.
  • Ensure secure configuration of cloud-native storage solutions.
  • Evaluate and enforce policies around public access and data loss prevention.
  • Ensure compliance with internal policies and external regulatory requirements.
  • Contribute to threat modeling, risk assessments, and architecture review processes.
  • Define and implement logging and monitoring strategies.
  • Collaborate with Security Operations and Incident Response teams.
  • Conduct security and privacy technology research and assessments.
  • Consult with customers to gather and evaluate functional requirements.
  • Provide advice and recommendations on cloud security topics.
  • Manage and measure information security implications within the organization.

Education and Experience:

  • Must have a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or related field, or equivalent professional experience.
  • Must have 7 years of experience in Cybersecurity with at least 3 years focused on cloud security in AWS.
  • Must have hands-on expertise in AWS services, Kubernetes security, and Infrastructure-as-Code security.

Preferred:

  • Cloud Security Certifications such as AWS Certified Security – Specialty, AWS Certified Solutions Architect, or similar.
  • Experience securing workloads across AWS, Azure, and GCP.
  • Familiarity with Zero Trust principles and secure service-to-service communication.

title: Senior Platform Engineer :: Bethesda, MD (Hybrid/Remote)
description:
Senior Platform Engineer

Bethesda, MD | Hybrid/Remote | 5-month Contract

Job Summary:

Seeking for a Senior Platform Engineer with strong software engineering skills, genuine database expertise, and a platform engineering orientation. You will be responsible for designing, automating, and operating production-scale database platforms that are secure, resilient, and easy for application teams to use. You will work closely with Site Reliability Engineering, Networking, Security, and Application Engineering teams to deliver database capabilities through our Internal Developer Platform.

Core Work Activities:

  • Design and build database infrastructure provisioning modules and automation pipelines.
  • Implement CI/CD automation for standardized and safe database platform changes.
  • Enable self-service database capabilities for application teams.
  • Develop platform tooling for database health, security, and compliance visibility.
  • Support strategic database migrations and develop migration patterns and standards.
  • Create guidance artifacts and documentation for supported database platforms.
  • Collaborate on database architecture, performance, and operational readiness.
  • Ensure database platforms align with security and compliance standards.
  • Integrate database services with IAM controls, networking, and configuration management.
  • Participate in technical discussions, shared documentation, and engineering standards.

Education and Experience:

Required:

  • Bachelor's degree in engineering or computer science discipline or equivalent professional experience.
  • 7 years of combined software and infrastructure engineering experience, with hands-on experience in distributed or document-oriented database technology.
  • Strong experience with Infrastructure as Code (especially Terraform), CI/CD pipelines, and cloud infrastructure (preferably AWS).
  • Proficiency in at least one general-purpose programming or scripting language (Python, Go, or equivalent).

Preferred:

  • Experience with Couchbase Server or Couchbase Capella, and/or AWS managed database services.
  • Experience with event-driven systems, workflow orchestration, and compliance automation tools.
  • Involvement in large-scale database migrations or backend software development experience.

title: Systems Engineer II (Systems Integration & Interoperability) :: Harrisburg, PA (Hybrid)
description:
Systems Engineer II – Systems Integration & Interoperability

Location: Harrisburg, PA

Duration: 9 months (Hybrid)

Position Summary:

The Systems Engineer II supports the design, integration, testing, deployment, and sustainment of enterprise health information technology solutions. This role involves working closely with technical teams, clinical stakeholders, and vendors to ensure system readiness and operational success.

  • Support design and integration of enterprise Health IT and EHR capabilities.
  • Translate clinical and operational requirements into technical specifications.
  • Implement scalable, cloud-based solutions in a federal healthcare environment.
  • Support healthcare interoperability and interface management efforts.
  • Assist with secure migration and support of clinical data in cloud-based repositories.
  • Participate in testing, validation, and readiness activities.
  • Coordinate with stakeholders for deployment support and issue resolution.
  • Identify and track technical risks and issues.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Systems Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, or related field.
  • 2–5 years of relevant experience in IT, systems engineering, or Health IT programs.
  • Experience with systems integration, interfaces, and EHR environments.
  • Experience documenting technical requirements and system processes.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience in healthcare IT environments.
  • Familiarity with federal healthcare operations or large-scale public sector IT programs.
  • Experience with cloud-based systems and secure data environments.
  • Familiarity with EHR sustainment and healthcare data standardization.

Required Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:

  • Strong understanding of systems engineering principles and interoperability concepts.
  • Ability to analyze technical requirements and identify integration constraints.
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
  • Effective communication skills with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

title: Sr Project Manager :: Richmond, VA (Hybrid)
description:
Sr Project Manager - Richmond, VA (Hybrid)

title: IT Support Specialist :: Denver, CO (REMOTE)
description:
IT Support Specialist 

Location: Denver, CO (REMOTE)

Duration: 12 months

Seeking for a skilled IT Support Specialist to provide technical support to both the Technology and the Automated Tracking System.

  • Assist with internal and external end-user technical support and incident management.

  • Manage support emails and calls from system users.
  • Update issue tracking systems with service desk report information.
  • Create and provide reports to interested groups.
  • Assign incident work items to team members as needed.

Responsibilities:

Preferred Qualifications

  • Three years of experience with Salesforce CRM and Jira.
  • Current Salesforce Administrator Certification in progress.

title: Senior Security Engineer :: Dover, DE (Onsite)
description:
Senior Security Engineer  

Duration: 10 months, Onsite at Dover, DE

Job Summary:

Seeking for a skilled cloud security professional with expertise in securing cloud workloads, tools, and services. A strong track record in Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA) principles and experience in managing secure cloud environments across multiple platforms is essential. Expertise in GCP cloud services is highly desired.

Core Technical Skills & Experience:

  • Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA): Experience in ZTNA engineering and automation, ensuring secure, scalable, and policy-driven access control. Familiarity with NIST 800-207 and Zscaler technologies.
  • Cloud Platform Expertise: Comprehensive understanding of cloud security platforms like Google, Amazon, and Microsoft. Ability to design and implement secure cloud architectures.
  • Identity and Access Management (IAM): Proficient in IAM concepts, least privilege access controls, and solutions like Okta.
  • Security Automation and Orchestration: Experience with automation tools such as Python, Terraform, and SOAR platforms.
  • Security Monitoring and Incident Response: Proficiency in SIEM logging, analysis, and incident response procedures.
  • Security Policy, Compliance, and Governance: Knowledge of security policies, compliance regulations, and governance standards.
  • Data Security: Understanding of data classification standards and data loss prevention (DLP) configurations.
  • Network Security: Extensive experience with network security concepts and technologies.
  • Endpoint Security: Understanding of endpoint security concepts and technologies.

Soft Skills & Experience:

  • Leadership and Communication: Ability to lead and mentor junior security engineers, with excellent communication skills.
  • Problem-Solving and Critical Thinking: Strong analytical skills, strategic thinking, and risk mitigation capabilities.

Education and Certifications (Preferred):

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or a related field.
  • Relevant certifications (e.g., CISSP, CCSP, AWS Certified Security – Specialty, Google Cloud Certified Professional Cloud Security Engineer, Microsoft Certified: Azure Security Engineer Associate).

Experience Level:

  • Minimum of 7-10 years of experience in information security, with a focus on cloud security and ZTNA.
  • Significant experience with GCP, AWS, and/or Azure.
  • Demonstrated experience in implementing and managing ZTNA solutions.

Required Skills:

  • Extensive experience in ZTNA engineering and automation.
  • Experience with Security Information and Event Management (SIEM).
  • Understanding of data classification standards and data loss prevention (DLP) configurations.
  • Understanding of endpoint security concepts and technologies.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to anticipate security risks and develop effective mitigation strategies.

title: Senior Project Manager - Harrisburg, PA (Hybrid/Remote)
description:
